data.name: Seventy Barcelona
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious Amenities
Seventy Barcelona boasts a spa and wellness center with both indoor and outdoor pools, a fitness center, and a sauna for ultimate relaxation during your stay.

Modern Comfort
Each room at Seventy Barcelona is equipped with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, and a private bathroom with free toiletries, ensuring a comfortable and convenient experience for all guests.

Prime Location
Conveniently situated near iconic landmarks such as La Pedrera and Casa Batllo, Seventy Barcelona offers easy access to Barcelona's top attractions. Book now to experience luxury and convenience in the heart of the city.

data.name: Acta Voraport
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious Accommodation with Stunning Amenities

Outdoor Swimming Pool and Terrace: Enjoy a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool or relax on the terrace soaking up the Barcelona sun.

Delicious Dining Options: Indulge in culinary delights at the on-site restaurant or grab a drink at the bar for a relaxing evening.

Convenient Services and Tour Assistance: Benefit from services like private parking, concierge assistance, and tour organization to make your stay stress-free and enjoyable.

Experience the best of Barcelona at Acta Voraport. Book now for an unforgettable stay with top-notch amenities and personalized service.

data.name: The Corner Hotel
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious Accommodation with Pool and Bar

Outdoor Swimming Pool & Terrace: Enjoy a relaxing dip in the outdoor swimming pool or unwind on the terrace while taking in the stunning views of Barcelona.

Modern Amenities: Each room at The Corner Hotel is equipped with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, and a private bathroom with luxurious bathrobes and slippers, ensuring a comfortable stay.

Central Location: Located just 1.1 km from Casa Batllo, with popular attractions like Passeig de Gracia and Plaça Catalunya nearby, The Corner Hotel is the perfect choice for travelers interested in exploring the city.

Experience luxury and convenience at The Corner Hotel. Book your stay now to enjoy a memorable experience in Barcelona.

data.name: Barcelona Princess
data.hotelDescription:
Spectacular Views and Free Amenities

Located just a 10-minute walk from the beach, Barcelona Princess Hotel in the city’s Forum area offers stunning views and a complimentary gym for guests. The hotel boasts two heated outdoor pools, with the one on the 23rd floor providing breathtaking sea views.

Elegant Rooms and Dining Options

The rooms at Princess Barcelona are elegantly designed with contemporary décor and feature amenities like satellite TV. Guests can enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at the hotel's restaurant and unwind at one of the two stylish bars, including a poolside bar with panoramic views.

Convenient Location and Easy Access

Situated on Avenida Diagonal, next to Diagonal Mar Shopping Centre, Princess Hotel Barcelona offers easy access to transportation with the tour bus stopping in front of the hotel and a nearby metro station. Explore top attractions like Plaza de Catalunya and Las Ramblas within a 15-minute metro ride. Book your stay now and experience the best of Barcelona!
